stemMarkdown: A boat travels downstream at 21 km/h and upstream at 7 km/h. Find the speed (in km/h) of the boat in still water.
solutionMarkdown: Downstream speed is boat $+$ stream and upstream is boat $-$ stream. Adding the two cancels the stream: boat speed $= \dfrac{21 + 7}{2} = 14$ km/h.
altSolutionMarkdown: Subtracting instead gives the stream speed: $\dfrac{21 - 7}{2} = 7$ km/h.
